premise.claim: The e2e case `warmup / should complete warmup job with targetRoleBasedGroup mode and merge multi-role actions` fails on any cluster with more than one schedulable node
premise.evidence: On a 3-node ACK cluster (all Ready, untainted), base cb14eee3 fails at warmup.go:215 with desired=2 succeeded=2 and one warmup Pod on each of two nodes -- byte-for-byte the signature quoted in the PR body. The same spec on head 7b544482 passes. results/L3-p0-base-FAIL.log, results/L3-p0-head-PASS.log

findings.claim: isNodeAvailable passes a nil inclusionFilter to FindMatchingUntoleratedTaint, so a PreferNoSchedule taint is treated as a hard block. kube-scheduler's TaintToleration plugin filters on Effect == NoSchedule || NoExecute, so such a node is schedulable for a tolerationless pod. On a cluster whose nodes carry a PreferNoSchedule taint, both loops in getFirstAvailableNodeName fall through and all five warmup cases die in ginkgo.Fail rather than running.
findings.proposedFix: pass func(t *corev1.Taint) bool { return t.Effect == corev1.TaintEffectNoSchedule || t.Effect == corev1.TaintEffectNoExecute } instead of nil

findings.claim: defaultPodTolerations cannot change any verdict once the Ready gate is in place: node.kubernetes.io/not-ready and unreachable are added exactly when Ready is False/Unknown, which isNodeAvailable already rejects. The inclusionFilter argument, not the toleration list, is what decides anything here.
findings.note: Observation, not a defect. Stays green before and after the F1 fix -- it is not a regression signal.

findings.claim: go.mod promotes k8s.io/component-helpers to a direct require while leaving it at v0.33.3, the only k8s.io direct dependency off the v0.34.1 line that the rest of the tree uses.
findings.note: No build impact: vendor/modules.txt already listed scheduling/corev1 + nodeaffinity, and go build -mod=vendor ./... plus go vet ./test/e2e/... are clean at head.

findings.claim: REVIEWER HYPOTHESIS, DISPROVED: the new k8s.io/component-helpers/scheduling/corev1 import is not vendored, so -mod=vendor builds break.
findings.note: vendor/modules.txt at head already lists all four component-helpers packages; build and vet are clean. Not a finding -- recorded so it is not re-raised.

liveNote: L3 needs a real multi-node cluster (>=2 Ready schedulable nodes) plus the rbgs controller installed. Run: KUBECONFIG=... go test ./test/e2e/ -v -ginkgo.v -ginkgo.focus='merge multi-role actions'. On base the observable signal is warmup status desired=2/succeeded=2 with one warmup Pod per node; on a correct fix it is desired=1/succeeded=1 with a single 2-container warmup Pod. A single-node cluster (what CI uses) cannot decide P0 at all.
